recognize_zh: 三顆單核球系細胞：左側細胞核分葉摺疊、胞質豐富灰藍；中間細胞胞質布滿細小嗜天青顆粒；右側核呈腎形。周邊血中出現多顆型態不一的單核球，符合CMML的單核球增多。
features: Three monocytic cells in peripheral blood
Left cell with lobulated, convoluted nucleus and abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm
Central cell with oval nucleus and cytoplasm dusted with fine azurophilic granules (immature monocyte/promonocyte versus granulocytic precursor)
Right cell with reniform nucleus and pale gray cytoplasm
Red cell with small dark inclusion at right (Howell-Jolly or Pappenheimer body)
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three monocytic cells with abnormal features. One has a lobulated, convoluted nucleus with abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, another has an oval nucleus with finely granular cytoplasm, and a third has a reniform nucleus with pale gray cytoplasm. A red cell contains a small dark inclusion. Findings are consistent with monocytosis with atypical monocytes, as seen in chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (persistent monocytes at least 0.5 x 10^9/L and at least 10% of leukocytes).

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes are uniform and mature without dysplasia in other lineages, and monocyte flow partitioning shows fewer than 94% classical monocytes.
AML shows at least 20% blasts plus promonocytes with fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli.
Myelocytes have round nuclei with coarser chromatin and pink secondary granules without the folded nuclei of monocytes; nonspecific esterase can help.
